title: Raw evaluation is natural on a prescribed injective resolution
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X\to S, a nonnegative integer q, an abelian etale sheaf F and the chosen injective resolution I, evaluation of a raw derived-Hom class followed by the fixed-resolution sections comparison commutes with every morphism of etale S-objects. The maps are exactly rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison, normalizationRestrictedIso, and homology of the presheaf complex normalizationPresheafComplex, as constructed in [def-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-normalization-data].

source.place: Tag 03Q8; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 072W; derived.tex Tags 0DVC and 09T5; fixed-resolution part of the parent normalization argument.

proof.text: Use fullness of localization into the shifted K-injective resolution and fullness of the homotopy quotient to write an arbitrary raw class as Q(c) followed by the inverse shifted augmentation. Naturality of localization identifies precomposition of this representative with the representative obtained by precomposing c with the single-complex map induced by the chart arrow.

The inverse-image/direct-image, sheafification and free-abelian adjunctions followed by the universe-lifted Yoneda equivalence identify maps out of the pulled-back free chart with sections. Their left naturality makes precomposition by a chart map exactly restriction of sections. Apply this to the identity map to identify the restricted represented generator with the generator mapped by the free chart arrow. Naturality of the termwise sections map and the degree-zero homology isomorphism of a single complex then gives naturality of chainEvaluation directly, without the Hom complex.

The naturality of the homology shift isomorphism and the termwise functor shift comparison undo the shift in that equality. Naturality of the evaluation/homology comparison moves chart restriction to homology of normalizationPresheafComplex. Finally rawRestricted_resolution_shift_square and rawRestricted_resolution_evaluation identify both evaluated representatives with the prescribed rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison followed by normalizationRestrictedIso. Extensionality gives the equality of group morphisms.

proof_origin.note: Explicit naturality on represented generators and single-complex homology, using the already stated shift square.
